task_name: Isla Verde - Monogram and wayfinding pictogram system
client_brief:
Resort identity recovery and a bilingual door-plate system

Isla Verde needs a specialist who is comfortable with both identity craft and production data. This is one coordinated job: recover the foil monogram, build the pictograms and make the bilingual plates fit the existing installation.

Final handoff

 Recovered Isla Verde monogram: 1 named export. The letterforms match the authoritative source, keeping its own letter shapes rather than re-setting the I and V in Lausanne 300 or any other typeface. The inter-letter relationships preserve the original identity.

 Wordless facility pictogram: 8 named exports. The complete symbol remains inside the export boundary. The symbol retains an open interior counter at 12 mm.

 Bilingual door plate: 25 named exports. The language pairing matches the schedule, and every line of wording on the plate, both names and the room numeral, has capitals or figures at least 8 mm tall, the door-plate minimum in islaverde_signshop_note.txt; a type-system size applies only where it is larger. The room identifier is unambiguous. The approved monogram is used.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Independent upscale coastal resort refreshing its corridor and garden wayfinding and its room signage.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Family owned, Gulf coast of Florida, a forty two room property with corridors, a garden path and about twenty four rooms and facilities.
brand_identity.about: Isla Verde is a family owned resort on the Gulf coast where guests come for quiet. Forty two rooms, refinished corridors and a garden that people walk slowly. The signage is being rebuilt this winter so the property reads as calmly as it feels, with the house monogram carried consistently from the door plates to the directional panels.
brand_identity.audience: Independent leisure travellers thirty to fifty five paying for calm, who notice when a place is shouting and value being able to find their way without being told loudly.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Upscale independent, rooms three hundred and eighty to six hundred and fifty a night. Signage should read at that tier: generous clear space, delicate marks, confidence rather than contrast for its own sake.

palette.name: Deep Palm
palette.role: mandatory on every door plate (the ground)
palette.usage: The solid ground of every door plate, as on islaverde_doorplate_2016.pdf. It may also be the single colour of monogram.svg and of each pictogram when drawn to sit on a light ground.

palette.name: Warm Stone
palette.usage: The room numeral or fine print on a Deep Palm plate, as islaverde_doorplate_2016.pdf sets its number. Never a ground, a panel, the English name or the Spanish line.

palette.name: Slate Grey
palette.usage: The 0.5 pt vertical hairline at one third of the plate width, and nothing else.

palette.name: Mist Grey
palette.usage: The Spanish line, set beneath the English name, and nothing else.

palette.name: Sand Cream
palette.role: mandatory on every door plate (English name and monogram)
palette.usage: The English name and the monogram reversed out of Deep Palm on every door plate, as on islaverde_doorplate_2016.pdf. It may also be the single colour of monogram.svg and of each pictogram when drawn to sit on Deep Palm.

palette.name: Ink Charcoal
palette.usage: Type on a light Sand Cream ground only; not used on the door plates, monogram.svg or the pictograms.

brand_identity.typography: Isla Verde runs on Lausanne 300 for the monogram and Tiempos Text for every word. Step 01, display, is Lausanne 300 at 26 pt on 29 pt leading tracked 0.020 em, the house monogram standing alone to the left of a 0.5 pt Slate Grey hairline set at exactly one third of the plate width on a 200 by 75 mm plate, with the room numeral opposite at 30 pt in Tiempos Text Medium 500 tracked 0.040 em. Step 02, subheading, is Tiempos Text Regular 400 at 20 pt on 24 pt leading, tracking zero, the English wording line to the right of the rule, which sets at 20 px on 30 px for screen wayfinding. Step 03, body, is Tiempos Text Regular 400 at 13 pt on 19 pt leading, tracking zero, set to a maximum of 65 characters, carrying directional wording and the Spanish second line, which always sets in Mist Grey. Step 04, fine print, is Tiempos Text Regular 400 at 9 pt on 13 pt leading tracked 0.030 em for hours and house notes. Type never crosses the rule.
brand_identity.voice: Understated, warm, precise. It gives directions without raising its voice. Example line: The spa is along the garden path, second door on the left.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No monogram source file survives. The designer moved abroad and nothing was handed back. The only decent record of the mark is a foil stamp on the cover of a brochure printed in 2019. The 2016 sign shop that cut the current door plates has since closed, though its press artwork for the plates is still on file.
brand_identity.values: A sense of quiet that guests can navigate, and a written standard so the next person who orders a sign does not invent something new.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Every plate is split by a 0.5 pt Slate Grey hairline at exactly one third of its width, with the monogram alone to the left of it and all wording to the right.

type_system.text_face: Tiempos Text Regular 400 (Tiempos Text Medium 500 for room numerals)

scale.note: On a 200 by 75 mm plate the monogram stands alone to the left of the 0.5 pt Slate Grey hairline set at exactly one third of the plate width. Opposite it, the room numeral sets at 30 pt in Tiempos Text Medium 500 tracked 0.040 em. Type never crosses the rule.
The first wording line to the right of the rule. The Spanish line follows beneath it at 13 pt in Mist Grey. Screen wayfinding sets the same line at 20 px on 30 px.

scale.sample: The spa is along the garden path, second door on the left.
scale.note: Directional wording, corridor directories and the Spanish second line, which always sets in Mist Grey.

scale.sample: The quiet coast. Please walk the garden path slowly.
scale.note: Hours, service notes and door plate secondary wording. Still to the right of the rule, with the same clear space as everything else on the plate.

type_system.signature_move: Every plate is split by a 0.5 pt Slate Grey hairline at exactly one third of its width, with the monogram alone in Lausanne 300 to the left of it and all wording in Tiempos Text to the right. That thin vertical is what a guest registers first.
rules: Never let type cross the rule.
The hairline is always 0.5 pt Slate Grey at exactly one third of the plate width, on every plate and panel.
The monogram stands alone to the left of the rule; all wording sits to the right of it.
The Spanish line always sets in Mist Grey, beneath the English line, at 13 pt.
Room numerals are Tiempos Text Medium 500 at 30 pt tracked 0.040 em.
Lausanne 300 is the monogram face only; Tiempos Text sets every word on the plate.
Signage keeps generous clear space and delicate marks: confidence rather than contrast for its own sake, never shouting.
The monogram is carried unchanged from the door plates to the directional panels; nobody invents a new one.

palette_rules.distribution: Every door plate is a solid Deep Palm ground, as on islaverde_doorplate_2016.pdf. On it the English name and the monogram are Sand Cream, as on islaverde_doorplate_2016.pdf; the Spanish line is Mist Grey and the 0.5 pt hairline Slate Grey, as the type rules set; the room numeral and any fine print are Sand Cream or Warm Stone. Each pictogram and monogram.svg are drawn in one solid colour, Deep Palm or Sand Cream: the mark is one solid Sand Cream reversed out of Deep Palm on islaverde_doorplate_2016.pdf and one light colour on a dark green panel on islaverde_existing_sign_01.jpg, so a transparent mark takes Sand Cream to sit on Deep Palm and Deep Palm to sit on a light ground. Warm Stone never forms a ground or panel, and Ink Charcoal appears on none of these deliverables.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, glow or blend mode is applied to any colour, and no mark carries tonal shading, highlights or texture: the monogram and the pictograms are flat, single-colour artwork. No photograph appears on any deliverable, so nothing is laid over one.
palette_rules.forbidden: No gold, champagne, silver or other metallic or foil effect on any mark, type, rule or plate, and no colour outside the six palette hexes for type, rules, grounds, marks or pictograms.
palette_rules.photography: No photograph or bitmap is placed on any deliverable. The supplied photographs, islaverde_brochure_cover.jpg, islaverde_location_01.jpg to islaverde_location_10.jpg and islaverde_existing_sign_01.jpg to islaverde_existing_sign_04.jpg, are references only; no colour is sampled from them.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Recover only features supported by the references; do not describe an automatic trace as engraving, cutting, embroidery, or press ready without inspectable path evidence.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
